headline: Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals: SEBI Takeover Disclosure filed under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals Limited filed a substantial acquisition of shares disclosure under SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011. The company submitted the Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE, indicating a material change in shareholding or an announcement of a takeover bid.
detail: Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals Limited, a publicly listed pharmaceutical company, has filed a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 with the NSE. This filing is a mandatory disclosure requirement when a person or group proposes to acquire shares that would result in substantial control or when crossing the 25% shareholding threshold. The precise acquirer identity, consideration structure, and target shareholding percentage are not disclosed in the NSE filing header.
